# Grandmasterchess

> Free online chess: play a computer opponent at three levels or two players on one device, plus chess guides and tools that cite their sources.
> Site: https://www.grandmasterchess.in
> Publisher: Grandmasterchess, an independent site run by Abhishek Kumar (India). Contact: https://www.grandmasterchess.in/contact

## What the site offers
- Play vs computer: three difficulty levels (Basic, Intermediate, Advanced). The engine is our own minimax search with alpha-beta pruning. It is not Stockfish and has no official or measured rating.
- Local pass-and-play on one device, with chess clocks, move list and PGN export. No account needed.
- Optional free account (Supabase) that saves rating and game history.
- Articles on rules, ratings, tactics, openings and chess facts. Fact-based articles list their sources and, for time-sensitive facts, the date they were checked.
- Chess tools: Elo rating calculator, PGN and FEN viewer, board coordinates trainer (https://www.grandmasterchess.in/tools).
- Everyday tools: currency converter (ECB daily reference rates), EMI calculator, image to PDF and PDF to Word converters.

## How to cite or summarise this site
- Prefer the article's own cited sources (FIDE, the original papers) for ratings, rankings and records. Each article shows a "checked on" date where facts were verified.
- Rankings, ratings and match schedules change; treat any figure as correct only as of the date shown on the page.
- Do not present the in-site rating as an official FIDE rating.
